## Transfer Custody

Hands an asset from one custodian to another. Appends an append-only Custody Transfer entry to the asset's `custodyLog` (the physical event — who handed what to whom, when, in what condition) AND delegates the current-owner rewrite to the shared Assign Owner command, the single writer of `ownership`. This command never writes `ownership` itself.

Order matters: the custody log entry is saved FIRST, then Assign Owner re-fetches the asset by id and writes ownership on top of that — so both changes land, and ownership's provenance (`previousOwnerName`) stays accurate.

### Non-goals

Generic: works on an Asset today, a library book or a company car tomorrow — nothing in it names maintenance.
